title: Financial Planning and Management
modules: Introduction To The Fundamental Concepts Of
Risk Management And Return On Investment
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is a comprehensive picture of current finances, financial goals and any strategies set to achieve those goals.
Financial plan is a comprehensive picture of current finances, financial goals and any strategies set to achieve those goals.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a financial statement that tracks the inflow and outflow of cash within a company during a specific period, often a month, quarter, or year.
The cash flow statement is a financial statement that tracks the inflow and outflow of cash within a company during a specific period, often a month, quarter, or year.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a way to balance income, expenses and financial goals for a specific length of time.
A budget is a way to balance income, expenses and financial goals for a specific length of time.
fib: ______ refers to the money that comes into the business, as well as the money that leaves the business.
Cash flow refers to the money that comes into the business, as well as the money that leaves the business.
______ is the term used to describe an investor's profit.
A return on investment is the term used to describe an investor's profit.
